meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从论文中快速获取方法、结果、样本量等结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured experimental details from scientific papers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索科学论文并返回结构化实验数据，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论，每篇论文返回 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当你需要查找科学论文中的具体实验细节、进行文献综述或证据综合时触发。

say.text: 搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文。
say.note: 返回结构化数据，包括方法、结果等。

say.text: 找一篇比较不同样本量的研究。
say.note: 返回包含样本量字段的论文。

howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find specific experimental details in scientific papers, conduct literature reviews, or synthesize evidence.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency.
